title: The inbox badge is red and moves the moment something happens
description: The unread count beside Inbox used to be a quiet blue number that only changed when the page reloaded. It is now red with a white number, and it goes up when a notification arrives and down when you read one, without the page you are on reloading.
items: Marking a notification read, or all of them, updates the row and the sidebar badge on the click
If the portal cannot save a read receipt, the row goes back to unread and says why, instead of looking read when it is not
The inbox list loads straight away when you come back to it
The project tree's task counts no longer undercount on very large departments
